transcript.en: Good morning. Thanks for coming in to see us here at the agency, Joe. I'm one of the agency representatives, and my name's Sally Baker.
transcript.zh: 早上好。乔,十分感谢你来公司见我。我是机构的代表之一,我叫萨利·贝克。

transcript.en: Hi Sally. I think we spoke on the phone, didn't we?
transcript.zh: 你好,萨利。我想我们之前通过电话,对吗?

transcript.en: That's right, we did. So thank you for sending in your CV. We've had quite a careful look at it and l think we have two jobs that might be suitable for you.
transcript.zh: 没错。感谢你发来你的简历。我们已经认真地看过了。我觉得目前可能有两份适合你的工作。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: The first one is in a company based in North London. They're looking for an administrative assistant.
transcript.zh: 第一份来自伦敦北部的一家公司。招聘的是行政助理。

transcript.en: OK. What sort of company is it?
transcript.zh: 好的。经营什么的公司?

transcript.en: They're called Home Solutions and they design and make furniture.
transcript.zh: 是一家设计制作家具的公司,叫做家装解决者。

transcript.en: Oh, I don't know much about that, but it sounds interesting.
transcript.zh: 是吗?我对它并不了解,但听起来不错。

transcript.en: Yes, well as I said, they want someone in their office, and looking at your past experience it does look as if you fit quite a few of the requirements. So on your CV it appears you've done some data entry?
transcript.zh: 是的,正如我刚才说到的,他们想要招聘一些办公室员工。你之前的经验看起来确实挺符合他们的要求的。简历上看,你之前做过数据录入工作,是吗?

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: So that's one skill they want. Then they expect the person they appoint to attend meetings and take notes there ...
transcript.zh: 这也正是他们希望员工掌握的技巧。另外,他们希望他们招聘的员工能够岀席会议并做好会议笔记。

transcript.en: OK. I've done that before, yes.
transcript.zh: 好的。我之前也做过这些。

transcript.en: And you'd need to be able to cope with general admin.
transcript.zh: 而且你要能适应总务部的工作。

transcript.en: Filing, and keeping records and so on? That should be OK. And in my last job I also had to manage the diary.
transcript.zh: 归档,然后做记录这些?应该没问题。上一份工作还需要我整理工作日志。

transcript.en: Excellent. That's something they want here too. I'd suggest you add it to your CV - I don't think you mentioned that, did you?
transcript.zh: 太好了。这也是他们要求的工作技能。我建议你把这些经验加到你的简历中,我记得你之前好像没提到,是吗?

transcript.en: No.
transcript.zh: 没有。

transcript.en: So as far as the requirements go, they want good computer skills, of course, and they particularly mention spreadsheets.
transcript.zh: 说到要求,熟练的电脑技能当然也是必须的。他们还特别提到了电子制表软件。

transcript.en: That should be fine.
transcript.zh: 这些应该也没问题。

transcript.en: And interpersonal skills - which would be something they'd check with your references.
transcript.zh: 还要有人际交往能力,他们可能会在你的推荐信中确认这个。

transcript.en: I think that should be OK, yes .
transcript.zh: 我觉得没问题。

transcript.en: Then they mention that they want someone who is careful and takes care with details - just looking at your CV, I'd say you're probably alright there.
transcript.zh: 还有他们提到了希望应聘者细心认真,注意细节。看你的简历,我觉得你可能也很符合。

transcript.en: I think so, yes. Do they want any special experience?
transcript.zh: 我觉得也是。需要特别的工作经验吗?

transcript.en: I think they wanted some experience of teleconferencing.
transcript.zh: 我觉得他们希望应聘者有过电话会议工作的经验。

transcript.en: I've got three years' experience of that.
transcript.zh: 我之前有过三年的经验。

transcript.en: Let's see, yes, good. In fact they're only asking for at least one year, so that's great. So is that something that might interest you?
transcript.zh: 我看看,哦,是的。事实上,他们要求的是至少有一年的工作经验,太棒了。所以这份工作你感兴趣吗?

transcript.en: It is, yes. The only thing is, you said they were in North London so it would be quite a long commute for me.
transcript.zh: 是的。唯一的就是你刚才提到他们是在伦敦北部,所以对我来说通勤时间会很长。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 理解了。

transcript.en: So the second position might suit you better as far as the location goes; that's for a warehouse assistant and that's in South London.
transcript.zh: 要是说地点的话,第二份工作也许更适合你。伦敦南部的一家公司在招聘仓库助理。

transcript.en: Yes, that would be a lot closer.
transcript.zh: 这样距离就近多了。

transcript.en: And you've worked in a warehouse before, haven't you?
transcript.zh: 你之前在仓库工作过,对吗?

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: So as far as the responsibilities for this position go, they want someone who can manage the stock, obviously , and also deliveries.
transcript.zh: 说到这份工作的职责,很明显,他们希望应聘者能够管理库存和交货。

transcript.en: That should be OK. You've got to keep track of stuff, but I've always been quite good with numbers.
transcript.zh: 这应该没问题。这份工作需要员工记录数字,而我对数字一向很在行。

transcript.en: Good. that's their first requirement. And they want someone who's computer literate, which we know you are.
transcript.zh: 太好了。这是第一个要求。他们还希望应聘者精通电脑,我知道这对你来说也没有问题。

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 确实。

transcript.en: Then they mention organisational skills. They want someone who's well organised.
transcript.zh: 然后他们还说到了组织技能。他们希望应聘者做事情要有条理。

transcript.en: Yes, I think I am.
transcript.zh: 好的,我觉得我还行。

transcript.en: And tidy?
transcript.zh: 还要利落。

transcript.en: Yes, they go together really, don't they?
transcript.zh: 是的,这两者是一致的,对不对?

transcript.en: Sure. Then the usual stuff; they want someone who can communicate well both orally and in writing.
transcript.zh: 确实。剩下的就是平常的要求了。他们希望应聘者有良好的口头和书面表达能力。

transcript.en: OK. And for the last warehouse job I had, one of the things I enjoyed most was being part of a team. I found that was really essential for the job.
transcript.zh: 知道了。我之前在仓库工作的时候,最享受的一件事儿就是成为团队的一员。我发现这对做好工作是十分重要的。

transcript.en: Excellent. Yes, they do mention that they want someone who's used to that, yes. Now when you were working in a warehouse last time, what sorts of items were you dealing with?
transcript.zh: 你说得太对了。是的,他们确实提到了希望应聘者能够习惯团队合作。好了。你上次在仓库工作是什么时候?你主要处理什么物品?

transcript.en: It was mostly bathroom and kitchen equipment, sinks and stoves and fridges.
transcript.zh: 主要是浴室和厨房设备,水槽、炉灶和冰箱。

transcript.en: So you're OK moving heavy things?
transcript.zh: 你能够搬重物吗?

transcript.en: Sure. I'm quite strong, and I've had the training.
transcript.zh: 当然。我身体很强壮,我之前接受过培训。

transcript.en: Good. Now as far as experience goes, they mention they want someone with a licence, and that you have experience of driving in London - so you can cope with the traffic and so on.
transcript.zh: 好的。说到经验,招聘单位希望应聘者有驾照,还要有在伦敦驾驶的经验。这样你可以应付交通情况等等。

transcript.en: Yes, no problem.
transcript.zh: 好的,没问题。

transcript.en: And you've got experience of warehouse work .. . and the final thing they mention is customer service. I think looking at your CV you're OK there .
transcript.zh: 你有过在仓库工作的经验.最后一项就是客户服务。我记得从你的简历上看你这方面还不错,

transcript.en: Right. So what about pay? Can you tell me a bit more about that, please ...
transcript.zh: 是的。薪酬怎么样呢?麻烦你告诉我一些关于报酬的信息...
